versos.grego: Παρῆσαν δέ τινες ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ καιρῷ ἀπαγγέλλοντες αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν Γαλιλαίων ὧν τὸ αἷμα Πειλᾶτος ἔμιξεν μετὰ τῶν θυσιῶν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
controles.kjv: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
controles.livre: E naquele mesmo tempo estavam ali presentes alguns, que lhe contavam dos galileus cujo sangue Pilatos tinha misturado com seus sacrifícios.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Δοκεῖτε ὅτι οἱ Γαλιλαῖοι οὗτοι ἁμαρτωλοὶ παρὰ πάντας τοὺς Γαλιλαίους ἐγένοντο, ὅτι ταῦτα πεπόνθασιν;

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galileans were sinners above all the Galileans, because they suffered such things?
controles.livre: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhes: Vós pensais que estes galileus foram mais pecadores, por terem sofrido estas coisas?

versos.grego: οὐχί, λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀλλ’ ἐὰν μὴ μετανοῆτε, πάντες ὁμοίως ἀπολεῖσθε.

controles.web: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
controles.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
controles.livre: Não, eu vos digo; antes, se vós não vos arrependerdes, todos de modo semelhante perecereis.

versos.grego: ἢ ἐκεῖνοι οἱ δέκα ὀκτὼ ἐφ’ οὓς ἔπεσεν ὁ πύργος ἐν τῷ Σιλωὰμ καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτούς, δοκεῖτε ὅτι αὐτοὶ ὀφειλέται ἐγένοντο παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ἱερουσαλήμ;

controles.web: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?
controles.kjv: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
controles.livre: Ou aqueles dezoito, sobre os quais a torre em Siloé caiu, matando-os; pensais que eram mais culpados dos que todos as pessoas que moravam em Jerusalém?

versos.grego: οὐχί, λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀλλ’ ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσητε, πάντες ὡσαύτως ἀπολεῖσθε.

controles.web: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
controles.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
controles.livre: Não, eu vos digo; antes, se vós não vos arrependerdes, todos de modo semelhante perecereis.

versos.grego: Ἔλεγεν δὲ ταύτην τὴν παραβολήν. συκῆν εἶχέν τις πεφυτευμένην ἐν τῷ ἀμπελῶνι αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἦλθεν ζητῶν καρπὸν ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ οὐχ εὗρεν.

controles.web: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and found none.
controles.kjv: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
controles.livre: E dizia esta parábola: Um certo homem tinha uma figueira plantada em sua vinha, e veio até ela para buscar fruto, e não achou.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τὸν ἀμπελουργόν Ἰδοὺ τρία ἔτη ἀφ’ οὗ ἔρχομαι ζητῶν καρπὸν ἐν τῇ συκῇ ταύτῃ καὶ οὐχ εὑρίσκω· ἔκκοψον αὐτήν· ἵνα τί καὶ τὴν γῆν καταργεῖ;

controles.web: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why does it waste the soil?’
controles.kjv: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
controles.livre: E disse ao que cuidava da vinha: Eis que há três anos, que venho para buscar fruto nesta figueira, e não o acho; corta-a; por que ainda ocupa inutilmente a terra?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει αὐτῷ Κύριε, ἄφες αὐτὴν καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἔτος, ἕως ὅτου σκάψω περὶ αὐτὴν καὶ βάλω κόπρια,

controles.web: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it, and fertilize it.
controles.kjv: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
controles.livre: E respondendo ele, disse-lhe: Senhor, deixa-a ainda este ano, até que eu a escave ao redor, e a adube;

versos.grego: κἂν μὲν ποιήσῃ καρπὸν εἰς τὸ μέλλον· εἰ δὲ μήγε, ἐκκόψεις αὐτήν.

controles.web: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
controles.kjv: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
controles.livre: E se der fruto, deixa-a ficar ; se não, tu a cortarás depois.

versos.grego: Ἦν δὲ διδάσκων ἐν μιᾷ τῶν συναγωγῶν ἐν τοῖς σάββασιν.

controles.web: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
controles.kjv: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
controles.livre: E ensinava em uma das sinagogas num sábado.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ γυνὴ πνεῦμα ἔχουσα ἀσθενείας ἔτη δέκα ὀκτώ, καὶ ἦν συνκύπτουσα καὶ μὴ δυναμένη ἀνακύψαι εἰς τὸ παντελές.

controles.web: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.
controles.kjv: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
controles.livre: E eis que estava ali uma mulher, que havia dezoito anos que tinha um espírito de enfermidade; e andava encurvada, e de maneira nenhuma ela podia se endireitar.

versos.grego: ἰδὼν δὲ αὐτὴν ὁ Ἰησοῦς προσεφώνησεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Γύναι, ἀπολέλυσαι τῆς ἀσθενείας σου,

controles.web: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
controles.kjv: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
controles.livre: E Jesus vendo-a, chamou-a para si, e disse-lhe: Mulher, livre estás de tua enfermidade.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτῇ τὰς χεῖρας· καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνορθώθη, καὶ ἐδόξαζεν τὸν Θεόν.

controles.web: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.
controles.kjv: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
controles.livre: E pôs as mãos sobre ela, e logo ela se endireitou, e glorificava a Deus.

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἀρχισυνάγωγος, ἀγανακτῶν ὅτι τῷ σαββάτῳ ἐθεράπευσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ἔλεγεν τῷ ὄχλῳ ὅτι Ἓξ ἡμέραι εἰσὶν ἐν αἷς δεῖ ἐργάζεσθαι· ἐν αὐταῖς οὖν ἐρχόμενοι θεραπεύεσθε καὶ μὴ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου.

controles.web: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”
controles.kjv: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
controles.livre: E o chefe da sinagoga, irritado por Jesus ter curado no sábado, respondendo, disse à multidão: Há seis dias em que se deve trabalhar; nestes dias, pois, vinde para ser curados, e não no dia de sábado.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Κύριος καὶ εἶπεν Ὑποκριταί, ἕκαστος ὑμῶν τῷ σαββάτῳ οὐ λύει τὸν βοῦν αὐτοῦ ἢ τὸν ὄνον ἀπὸ τῆς φάτνης καὶ ἀπαγαγὼν ποτίζει;

controles.web: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?
controles.kjv: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
controles.livre: Porém o Senhor lhe respondeu, e disse: Hipócrita, no sábado cada um de vós não desata seu boi ou jumento da manjedoura, e o leva para dar de beber?

versos.grego: ταύτην δὲ θυγατέρα Ἀβραὰμ οὖσαν, ἣν ἔδησεν ὁ Σατανᾶς ἰδοὺ δέκα καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη, οὐκ ἔδει λυθῆναι ἀπὸ τοῦ δεσμοῦ τούτου τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου;

controles.web: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
controles.kjv: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
controles.livre: E não convinha soltar desta ligadura no dia de sábado a esta mulher ,que é filha de Abraão, a qual, eis que Satanás já a havia ligado há dezoito anos?

versos.grego: καὶ ταῦτα λέγοντος αὐτοῦ κατῃσχύνοντο πάντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι αὐτῷ, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἔχαιρεν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐνδόξοις τοῖς γινομένοις ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed, and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
controles.kjv: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
controles.livre: E ele, dizendo estas coisas, todos seus adversários ficaram envergonhados; e todo o povo se alegrava de todas as coisas gloriosas que eram feitas por ele.

versos.grego: Ἔλεγεν οὖν Τίνι ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ τίνι ὁμοιώσω αὐτήν;

controles.web: He said, “What is the Kingdom of God like? To what shall I compare it?
controles.kjv: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
controles.livre: E dizia: A que o Reino de Deus é semelhante? E a que eu o compararei?

versos.grego: ὁμοία ἐστὶν κόκκῳ σινάπεως, ὃν λαβὼν ἄνθρωπος ἔβαλεν εἰς κῆπον ἑαυτοῦ, καὶ ηὔξησεν καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς δένδρον, καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν τοῖς κλάδοις αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and put in his own garden. It grew, and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky lodged in its branches.”
controles.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
controles.livre: Semelhante é ao grão da mostarda, que um homem, tomando-o, lançou-o em sua horta; e cresceu, e fez-se uma grande árvore, e as aves dos céus fizeram ninhos em seus ramos.

versos.grego: Καὶ πάλιν εἶπεν Τίνι ὁμοιώσω τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ;

controles.web: Again he said, “To what shall I compare the Kingdom of God?
controles.kjv: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
controles.livre: E disse outra vez: A que compararei o Reino de Deus?

versos.grego: ὁμοία ἐστὶν ζύμῃ, ἣν λαβοῦσα γυνὴ ἔκρυψεν εἰς ἀλεύρου σάτα τρία, ἕως οὗ ἐζυμώθη ὅλον.

controles.web: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
controles.kjv: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
controles.livre: Semelhante é ao fermento, que a mulher, tomando-o, o escondeu em três medidas de farinha, até tudo ficar levedado.

versos.grego: Καὶ διεπορεύετο κατὰ πόλεις καὶ κώμας διδάσκων καὶ πορείαν ποιούμενος εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

controles.web: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E andava de cidade em cidade, e de aldeia em aldeia ensinando, e caminhando para Jerusalém.

versos.grego: Εἶπεν δέ τις αὐτῷ Κύριε, εἰ ὀλίγοι οἱ σῳζόμενοι; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς

controles.web: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?”   He said to them,
controles.kjv: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
controles.livre: E disse-lhe um: Senhor, são também poucos os que se salvam? E ele lhes disse:

versos.grego: Ἀγωνίζεσθε εἰσελθεῖν διὰ τῆς στενῆς θύρας, ὅτι πολλοί, λέγω ὑμῖν, ζητήσουσιν εἰσελθεῖν καὶ οὐκ ἰσχύσουσιν.

controles.web: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in, and will not be able.
controles.kjv: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
controles.livre: Trabalhai para entrar pela porta estreita; porque eu vos digo, que muitos procuraram entrar, e não puderam.

versos.grego: ἀφ’ οὗ ἂν ἐγερθῇ ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης καὶ ἀποκλείσῃ τὴν θύραν, καὶ ἄρξησθε ἔξω ἑστάναι καὶ κρούειν τὴν θύραν λέγοντες Κύριε, ἄνοιξον ἡμῖν· καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ἐρεῖ ὑμῖν Οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς πόθεν ἐστέ.

controles.web: When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside, and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
controles.kjv: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
controles.livre: Porque quando o chefe da casa se levantar, e fechar a porta, e se estiverdes de fora, e começardes a bater à porta, dizendo: Senhor, senhor, abre-nos! E respondendo ele, vos disser: Não vos conheço, nem sei de onde vós sois.

versos.grego: τότε ἄρξεσθε λέγειν Ἐφάγομεν ἐνώπιόν σου καὶ ἐπίομεν, καὶ ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις ἡμῶν ἐδίδαξας·

controles.web: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
controles.kjv: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
controles.livre: Então começareis a dizer: Em tua presença temos comido e bebido, e tens ensinado em nossas ruas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐρεῖ λέγων ὑμῖν Οὐκ οἶδα πόθεν ἐστέ· ἀπόστητε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ πάντες ἐργάται ἀδικίας.

controles.web: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
controles.kjv: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
controles.livre: E ele dirá: Digo-vos que não vos conheço, nem sei de onde vós sois; afastai-vos de mim, vós todos praticantes de injustiça.

versos.grego: ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων, ὅταν ὄψησθε Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ καὶ πάντας τοὺς προφήτας ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὑμᾶς δὲ ἐκβαλλομένους ἔξω.

controles.web: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets, in the Kingdom of God, and yourselves being thrown outside.
controles.kjv: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
controles.livre: Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes, quando virdes a Abraão, a Isaque, a Jacó, e a todos os profetas no Reino de Deus; mas vós sendo lançados fora.

versos.grego: καὶ ἥξουσιν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν καὶ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ νότου, καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in the Kingdom of God.
controles.kjv: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: E virão pessoas do oriente, e do ocidente, e do norte, e do sul, e se sentarão à mesa no Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ εἰσὶν ἔσχατοι οἳ ἔσονται πρῶτοι, καὶ εἰσὶν πρῶτοι οἳ ἔσονται ἔσχατοι.

controles.web: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
controles.kjv: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
controles.livre: E eis que há alguns dos últimos que serão primeiros, e há alguns dos primeiros que serão últimos.

versos.grego: Ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ προσῆλθάν τινες Φαρισαῖοι λέγοντες αὐτῷ Ἔξελθε καὶ πορεύου ἐντεῦθεν, ὅτι Ἡρῴδης θέλει σε ἀποκτεῖναι.

controles.web: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
controles.kjv: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
controles.livre: Naquele mesmo dia, chegaram uns fariseus, dizendo-lhe: Sai, e vai-te daqui, porque Herodes quer te matar.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες εἴπατε τῇ ἀλώπεκι ταύτῃ Ἰδοὺ ἐκβάλλω δαιμόνια καὶ ἰάσεις ἀποτελῶ σήμερον καὶ αὔριον, καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ τελειοῦμαι.

controles.web: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Ide, e dizei a aquela raposa: eis que expulso demônios, e faço curas hoje e amanhã, e ao terceiro dia eu terei completado.

versos.grego: πλὴν δεῖ με σήμερον καὶ αὔριον καὶ τῇ ἐχομένῃ πορεύεσθαι, ὅτι οὐκ ἐνδέχεται προφήτην ἀπολέσθαι ἔξω Ἱερουσαλήμ.

controles.web: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet perish outside of Jerusalem.’
controles.kjv: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Porém é necessário que hoje, e amanhã, e no dia seguinte eu caminhe; porque um profeta não pode morrer fora de Jerusalém.

versos.grego: Ἱερουσαλὴμ Ἱερουσαλήμ, ἡ ἀποκτείνουσα τοὺς προφήτας καὶ λιθοβολοῦσα τοὺς ἀπεσταλμένους πρὸς αὐτήν, ποσάκις ἠθέλησα ἐπισυνάξαι τὰ τέκνα σου ὃν τρόπον ὄρνις τὴν ἑαυτῆς νοσσιὰν ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας, καὶ οὐκ ἠθελήσατε.

controles.web: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
controles.kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
controles.livre: Jerusalém, Jerusalém, que matas aos profetas, e apedrejas aos que te são enviados: quantas vezes eu quis juntar teus filhos, como a galinha junta seus pintos debaixo de suas asas, e não quisestes?

versos.grego: ἰδοὺ ἀφίεται ὑμῖν ὁ οἶκος ὑμῶν. λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ ἴδητέ με ἕως ἥξει ὅτε εἴπητε Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου.

controles.web: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
controles.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
controles.livre: Eis que vossa casa é deixada deserta para vós. E em verdade vos digo, que não me vereis até que venha o tempo em que digais: Bendito aquele que vem no nome do Senhor.
